text:
Alex H: Quick sync — final devexp launch cutoff is Friday 3:00pm PT. Need owners for:
- Changelog aggregation
- Docs final pass
- Sample apps smoke + quickstarts
- SDK packaging and release
Please call it out if you're owning and any blockers.

Maria G: I can own changelog aggregation. I'll collect PRs and drafts — aiming for Thu 12:00pm PT cutoff. Please tag PRs with `changelog:devexp`.

Sam T: I'll do sample app smoke and quickstart updates. Need the image tag from eng-runtime — what's the canonical tag?

Tara L: Docs final pass — I can do Fri morning (9am PT). Question: do we include the new streaming API in the quickstarts or leave for GA note?

Chris P: Blocker on sampleapp/cli e2e — auth change broke login flow. Linked PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sampleapp/pull/421. Need eng-auth on a fix; pinging @eng-auth.

Jen K: SDK packaging — we need a freeze for binary artifacts Thu EOD. Packaging command for reference:
``
./scripts/package-sdk.sh --tag v0.9.0-rc --os linux,mac
```
I need final CHANGELOG entries by Thu 6pm PT.

release-bot: Reminder — canary window opens Fri 4pm PT. See runbook: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/devexp-canary

docs-bot: Staging site updated: https://staging.docs.redwood.dev/devexp/v0.9 — latest from branch `docs/devexp-0.9`

Alex H: TL;DR owners:
- Changelog: Maria G
- Docs final: Tara L
- Sample apps + quickstart smoke: Sam T
- SDK packaging: Jen K
Can each owner confirm and post any hard blockers by Wed EOD? If eng-runtime or eng-auth need to cut binary/compat builds, please @mention them.

Maria G: Confirmed. I'll start a changelog PR draft and drop the template in #devex-changelogs.

Sam T: Confirmed. @eng-runtime — please publish build tag `devexp-0.9-rc` by Wed 10am PT. Otherwise I'll use `latest` and we might have flaky tests.

Tara L: Confirmed. I'll hold a 30-min docs sync Thu 11am PT for any last-minute API notes.

Chris P: @eng-auth reported they'll have a patch by Tue night. I'll queue e2e rerun Wed morning.

Jen K: Confirmed. Will coordinate with Eng Infra for the release pipeline cut. :thumbsup:

Alex H: Thanks everyone. I'll compile status on Thu 12:30pm PT and send final go/no-go notes.
